def _router_added(self, router_id, router):
        """Operations when a router is added.

        Create a new RouterInfo object for this router and add it to the
        service helpers router_info dictionary.  Then `router_added()` is
        called on the device driver.

        :param router_id: id of the router
        :param router: router dict
        :return: None
        """
        ri = RouterInfo(self.agent_conf,
                        router_id,
                        router,
                        self.agent_conf.interface_driver,
                        self.agent_conf.use_namespaces,
                        self.agent_conf.router_id,
                        self.agent_conf.use_ipv6,
                        self.agent_conf.enable_metadata_proxy,
                        self.agent_conf.enable_new_ip_for_metadata_proxy,
                        self.agent_conf.send_arp_for_ha,
                        self.agent_conf.enable_radvd,
                        self.agent_conf.use_ipv6_mtu_size,
                        self.agent_conf.enable_ra_for_ha,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_restart_interval,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_interval,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_min_interval,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_max_interval,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_managed_config_action,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_other_config_action,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_min_rtr_adv_interval,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_max_rtr_adv_interval,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_lifetime,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_hop_limit,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_reachable_time,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_retrans_time,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_send_hostname,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_managed_flag_length,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_other_flag_length,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_mtu_flag_length,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_mtu_length,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_prefix_flag_length,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_prefix_length,
                        self.agent_conf.ra_prefix_val_
